newsitem.title: CANADA: Northstar makes good on share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Northstar makes good on share buyback.

text.p: Northstar Energy Corp said on Wednesday it would buy back up to C$300 million of its issued and outstanding shares through a dutch auction.
Northstar disclosed the buyback plan in February when it announced its stock swap merger with Morrison Petroleums Ltd.
The purchase price under the bid would range from C$14.50 to C$16.50 a share, the company said.

Under the deal, shareholders would submit the price range at which they wished to sell their shares. The actual price for the issuer bid would be the lowest clearing price that enabled Northstar to buy up to C$300 million worth of stock.
Shares tendered at or below the final price would be purchased for that amount, subject to proration, and shares tendered above the final price would be returned to holders, Northstar said.
The company, which finalized its merger with Morrison this week, said it expected to mail its issuer bid documents on or about March 21.
